newsitem.title: USA: Artra Group Inc Q4 oper loss narrows.
newsitem.headline: Artra Group Inc Q4 oper loss narrows.

text.p: Oper shr loss $0.04 loss $0.73
Oper net profit 26 loss 4,400
Avg shrs 8,112 6,924
(All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: Q4 oper net profit is before $158,000 in preferred stock dividends vs $143,000, and $93,000 reduction of retained earnings applicable to redeemable common stock vs $521,000.
Year-ago Q4 loss is before $9,166,000 or $1.36 a share earnings from discontinued operations, and $4,917,000 or $0.71 a share extraordinary credit from gains resulting from net discharge of debt.
Q4 1996 results include $995,000 gain from disposal of Comforce Corp common stock.
After all items, Q4 1996 net was loss $225,000 or $0.04 a share vs profit $9,019,000 or $1.34 a share.
